title: Install Daedalus only from the official distribution

summary.text: The official Daedalus 7.1.0 release links the Mainnet download to daedaluswallet.io and testnet downloads to docs.cardano.org.

problem.text: A user needs to distinguish publisher-linked Daedalus downloads from untrusted distribution links.

symptoms.text: The user needs a Mainnet or testnet Daedalus installer and is uncertain which download location is official.

daedalus.notes: Download destinations are documented by the 7.1.0 release; re-check a newer official release for current destinations.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

diagnostics.action: Compare the download origin with the official site linked from the Daedalus repository.

resolutions.action: Download using the official Daedalus site linked by the official repository.
resolutions.why: The repository is controlled by the publisher.

expected_outcome.text: The user follows the download destinations and integrity information published in the official release.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, or spending passwords.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Do not enter a recovery phrase merely to verify a download.
consequences: A counterfeit wallet can compromise funds.
recovery: If a phrase was entered into suspected software, treat the wallet as compromised and seek official incident guidance.

evidence.rationale: The publisher repository directly identifies the official download location.
